channel.title: United States passport: visa rule changes
channel.description: Destinations whose entry rule changed for United States passport holders, found by the daily comparison of public visa-policy sources (mainly Wikipedia). Check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Palau: Visa required → Visa-free
item.description: Palau: visa required before, visa-free now, for United States passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 30 June 2026.

item.title: North Korea: Visa required → No entry allowed
item.description: North Korea: visa required before, no entry allowed now, for United States passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 19 June 2026.
